feature_requests.title: Unified Capital & Leverage Cockpit
feature_requests.rationale: Single screen showing deployed capital, free margin, notional exposure (delta-adjusted for options), and leverage ratio across equity intraday + monthly F&O + weekly index options. Unlocks the 'am I over-leveraged right now?' decision before adding any new position — critical when straddles and pyramids stack silently.

feature_requests.title: Strategy Edge Decay Chart (rolling expectancy by strategy)
feature_requests.rationale: Rolling 20/60-trade expectancy, win-rate, and avg R per strategy plotted over time, with a regime overlay (trending vs choppy NIFTY). Lets me kill or down-size strategies whose edge has decayed before the monthly P&L tells me. Today the monthly report is lagging — this is the leading indicator.

feature_requests.title: Plan vs Actual Reconciliation Report
feature_requests.rationale: For every AI-generated plan (directional, straddle, pyramid, spread), compare planned entry/SL/target/size vs what actually executed and the realised outcome. Surfaces slippage, sizing drift, and SL-honour rate. Without this I can't tell if the AI plans are good and execution is bad, or vice versa.

feature_requests.title: Options Greeks Heatmap (portfolio-level delta/gamma/theta/vega)
feature_requests.rationale: Live aggregated Greeks across ALL open option positions (straddles + pyramids + spreads) by underlying and expiry bucket, with a gamma-risk badge for expiry-day positions. Unlocks the 'should I hedge or close before 3:15' decision — currently I have to eyeball positions one-by-one.

feature_requests.title: Signal-to-Trade Funnel (capture-rate breakdown)
feature_requests.rationale: Funnel view: signals fired → passed risk gate → executed → profitable, sliced by strategy and rejection reason from @RiskGuard. Tells me whether I'm leaving edge on the table due to over-tight risk limits or capital cap. Complements the monthly capture matrix but live/intraday instead of EOD.

feature_requests.title: Daily Risk Budget & Drawdown Anatomy
feature_requests.rationale: Top-of-screen tile showing today's used vs allowed risk (1% per trade, 3% daily loss cap), open-trade risk-at-stop, and a 30-day intraday-drawdown waterfall sliced by strategy + workflow. Lets me decide instantly whether to take the next setup or stop trading for the day, and which strategy is bleeding the daily budget.

feature_requests.title: Theta Decay & Premium-Burn Forecast Curve
feature_requests.rationale: For all open short-premium positions (straddles + short legs of spreads), project per-minute theta capture vs realised P&L till 3:15 PM, with a 'breakeven move in underlying' band overlaid. Tells me whether the position is still worth holding for theta or if I'm now net-short gamma without enough premium left to justify the risk.

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Tactical Cockpit (NIFTY Tue / SENSEX Thu)
feature_requests.rationale: Dedicated screen that auto-activates on expiry days: time-to-3:15PM countdown, ATM pin probability, gamma exposure by strike, mandatory close-list with one-click square-off, and a forced-flat checklist by 3:10 PM. Enforces invariant #5 (close expiry positions before 3:15) instead of relying on memory during the highest-risk session of the week.

feature_requests.title: Broker vs Journal Reconciliation Report
feature_requests.rationale: End-of-day diff between Angel One ledger (positions, charges, realised P&L, margin used) and our internal TradeJournal + PortfolioSnapshot. Surfaces missed fills, ghost positions, brokerage drag eating edge, and silent paper-vs-live divergence — critical before scaling capital from 5L upward.

feature_requests.title: Regime-Conditioned Strategy Allocation Heatmap
feature_requests.rationale: Matrix of strategy × NIFTY regime (trending up / trending down / chop / high-VIX / low-VIX) showing historical expectancy and trade count in each cell, plus today's detected regime highlighted. Tells me which strategies to enable/disable at 9:15 AM based on the morning regime read instead of running everything blindly.

feature_requests.title: Liquidity & Slippage Cost Map (per-symbol bid-ask + impact)
feature_requests.rationale: Show live bid-ask spread, 5-level depth imbalance, and historical fill-vs-mid slippage for every symbol on the watchlist + open positions. Tells me which strikes/stocks are safe to scale into and which will eat 30+ bps on exit — critical for SENSEX/BANKNIFTY options where depth is thin and for sizing the 4th pyramid leg.

feature_requests.title: Cross-Position Correlation & Concentration Matrix
feature_requests.rationale: Heatmap of pairwise return correlation between every open position (equity + options delta-adjusted) plus a 'true independent bets' count and sector/factor concentration bars. Unlocks the decision of whether adding another BANKNIFTY pyramid or HDFCBANK long is a new bet or just leveraging the same exposure 3x — directly informs the daily risk cap.

feature_requests.title: What-If Position Sizer & Pre-Trade Impact Simulator
feature_requests.rationale: Interactive panel where I dial lots/qty and instantly see post-trade portfolio delta, margin used, free cash, leverage ratio, distance to 3% daily-loss cap, and worst-case loss-at-stop. Today I have to mentally combine 4 cockpits to know if 'one more lot' breaks a limit — this collapses that into one slider before I click Buy.

feature_requests.title: Trade Post-Mortem Auto-Annotator (loss attribution by cause)
feature_requests.rationale: Per closed trade, classify the outcome driver: SL too tight, exit too early, sizing too small, slippage, news shock, regime mismatch, or thesis wrong — with the supporting chart + plan-vs-actual data inline. Daily/weekly roll-up converts vague 'I should improve' into a ranked checklist of behavioural fixes that compounds edge over months.

feature_requests.title: Overnight Gap Risk & Pre-Market Exposure Dashboard
feature_requests.rationale: For positions held overnight (monthly F&O, swing equity, carried straddles), show implied gap from SGX NIFTY + Dow + ADRs + overnight option chain skew, with projected P&L at +/-0.5/1/2% gaps and a 'forced action before 9:15' list. Lets me decide at 8:45 AM IST whether to hedge with futures, trim, or stand pat — currently this is a manual scramble across 5 browser tabs.

feature_requests.title: Live Skew & Term-Structure Surface (25Δ RR, fly, ATM IV per expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Single panel showing 25-delta risk-reversal and butterfly across the next 4 NIFTY + BANKNIFTY weekly/monthly expiries, plus ATM IV term-structure slope. Lets me see when puts are bid (fear) vs calls (squeeze) and whether the front-week is rich vs back-month — the entry signal for calendars, diagonals, and skew trades.

feature_requests.title: IV Rank & IV Percentile Board (rolling 30/60/252d per expiry bucket)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-underlying IV rank for ATM, 25Δ wings, and realised-vs-implied spread bucketed by DTE. Tells me instantly whether to be a premium seller (high IV rank) or a buyer (low rank), and flags IV crush windows around RBI/Fed/earnings so I scale straddles correctly.

feature_requests.title: Greeks-Overlay Payoff Builder with Live Δ/Γ/Θ/Vega Heatmap
feature_requests.rationale: Interactive payoff diagram for any straddle/strangle/spread/iron-condor with per-strike greeks coloured along the price-time grid, T+0 / T+1 / expiry curves, and a vega-shock toggle (+/-2 vol pts). Replaces the mental math I do today before scaling or rolling — shows where gamma punishes me and where theta actually accrues.

feature_requests.title: Portfolio Delta-Drift Monitor with Auto-Hedge Suggestions
feature_requests.rationale: Live aggregate Δ across all open option positions with a tolerance band (e.g. ±0.10 of notional); when drift breaches, propose the cheapest hedge (futures lots vs ATM option vs offsetting strike) ranked by theta cost and margin impact. Keeps short straddles/strangles delta-neutral without me re-hedging manually every 20 minutes.

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Pin-Risk & Max-Pain Tracker (intraday OI migration)
feature_requests.rationale: On NIFTY Tue / SENSEX Thu, plot max-pain strike, gamma-flip level, and OI add/unwind by strike every 5 min, with alerts when spot is within 0.25% of a high-gamma strike inside the last 90 minutes. Critical for sized short-gamma books — tells me when to flatten vs let theta finish.

feature_requests.title: Capital Deployment Allocation Wheel (bucket × instrument × expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Sunburst showing exactly how my 500k is parked: equity intraday vs monthly F&O vs weekly options vs free cash, then sliced by underlying and DTE bucket. Today I have no single view of 'where is my capital right now' — I infer it from positions + margin. This unlocks the decision to rebalance before adding a correlated new trade.

feature_requests.title: SPAN+Exposure Stress-Test Cockpit (spot ±1/2/3% & vol ±2pts)
feature_requests.rationale: Live margin used, free cash, and SPAN+exposure projected under spot and vol shocks, with a margin-call probability per scenario. The existing risk-budget tile covers 1%/3% loss caps but says nothing about leverage breaking under a gap. Lets me know if I can carry another lot or must trim before close.

feature_requests.title: Event & Earnings Risk Calendar Overlay (30-day forward)
feature_requests.rationale: Forward calendar with RBI policy, Fed FOMC, budget, expiry, and earnings for every held equity name, flagged by my open position size. I currently learn about these from Telegram or by accident. This unlocks pre-event hedge/trim decisions instead of post-event regret.

feature_requests.title: Realized vs Implied Vol Edge Tracker (RV-IV spread regime bands)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-underlying time series of 20d realized vol vs ATM IV, with regime bands (premium-rich, fair, premium-poor) so I can size short-vol trades only when the edge is statistically there. IV-rank board (already requested) tells me the level; this tells me whether the level is justified — the difference between a trade and a fade.

feature_requests.title: Kelly-Optimal Sizing Recommender per Strategy
feature_requests.rationale: From historical SignalLog + TradeJournal, compute per-strategy edge, win rate, and payoff ratio, then surface full-Kelly + fractional-Kelly (0.25x/0.5x) recommended bet size vs what I'm actually deploying. Tells me which strategies I'm starving and which I'm over-betting given their realized edge.

feature_requests.title: Live IV Term Structure & IV Rank Board (next 4 weekly expiries)
feature_requests.rationale: Plot ATM IV across the next 4 NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/SENSEX expiries with IV rank/percentile vs trailing 60d for each tenor, plus contango/backwardation flag. Lets me pick the tenor with richest premium and avoid selling already-crushed weeklies the morning after a vol spike.

feature_requests.title: 25-Delta Risk-Reversal & Butterfly Skew Snapshot
feature_requests.rationale: Show live 25Δ put-call skew and 25Δ butterfly per expiry with intraday timeline and 20d Z-score. Skew steepening on NIFTY weeklies is my earliest signal that put protection is being bid — I want to fade or align with it instead of guessing from the chain.

feature_requests.title: Dealer Gamma Exposure (GEX) Map by Strike
feature_requests.rationale: Compute aggregate dealer gamma per strike from OI × gamma × contract multiplier, mark zero-gamma flip level, and overlay spot. Above flip = mean-reverting/pin-prone (good for short straddle), below flip = trend-amplifying (kill short premium, lean long gamma). Today I have no view of this regime.

feature_requests.title: Realized-vs-Implied Edge Per Expiry with Forward P&L Projection
feature_requests.rationale: For each open or candidate weekly, compute trailing 5/10/20d realized vol annualized and current IV, and project expected straddle P&L if RV mean-reverts to trailing median. Sizes my short-vol bets only when IV-RV spread is statistically rich for that specific DTE.

feature_requests.title: Event-Driven IV Crush Playbook (FOMC/RBI/Budget/Earnings)
feature_requests.rationale: Forward calendar of vol events with historical pre-event IV ramp and post-event crush magnitude per underlying, plus pre-built calendar-spread/iron-fly templates sized to my risk budget. Right now I leg into event trades manually and routinely miss the crush window.

feature_requests.title: Live Basis & Cost-of-Carry Monitor (spot vs current/next futures)
feature_requests.rationale: Real-time chart of futures-minus-spot basis for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/held single-stock futures, annualised against MIBOR + dividend-adjusted fair value, with premium/discount Z-score vs trailing 20d. Lets me spot when the front-month is rich enough to short-future / long-cash arb, or cheap enough to roll early.

feature_requests.title: OI vs Price Quadrant Heatmap (Long/Short Build-up & Unwind)
feature_requests.rationale: Classify every F&O symbol into the four OI quadrants (long build-up, short build-up, long unwind, short cover) using delta-OI vs delta-price intraday and EOD, sized by notional. One screen tells me where smart money is adding conviction vs covering — drives my futures trend bias.

feature_requests.title: Roll-Day Calendar & Current-vs-Next Spread Tracker
feature_requests.rationale: Forward calendar of monthly expiries (last Thursday) per symbol with current-month vs next-month spread, rolled-OI %, and historical roll-cost percentile for the last 6 expiries. Tells me when to roll my carried futures position — early when spread is rich, late when next month is at discount.

feature_requests.title: SPAN+ELM Margin Efficiency Table (notional-per-margin per symbol)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-symbol live SPAN + ELM + exposure margin vs notional, with margin-utilisation % of free cash and a rank of 'biggest bang per rupee of margin'. Critical for futures because BANKNIFTY/SBIN-FUT eat margin very differently — I need to deploy the limited margin where edge × leverage is highest.

feature_requests.title: EOD Mark-to-Market & Settlement Preview (3:20 PM cutoff)
feature_requests.rationale: Pre-3:30 IST preview of today's MTM debit/credit per futures position using the running settlement price, projected impact on free cash tomorrow, and a flag for positions likely to trigger margin top-up calls overnight. Avoids T+1 morning surprises that have caught me before.

feature_requests.title: RS-vs-NIFTY Leaderboard (1M/3M/6M Mansfield RS)
feature_requests.rationale: Rank NIFTY 500 by Mansfield Relative Strength across 1M/3M/6M with new-RS-high flags and sector tags. Swing entries should come from the top RS decile that's also above 50/200 DMA — right now I eyeball this from Chartink instead of having it native. Surfaces leadership rotation a week before price confirms.

feature_requests.title: Multi-Timeframe Stage Scanner (Weinstein + Kell aligned)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-symbol D/W/M stage (Weinstein 1-4) plus Oliver-Kell phase, with a 'triple-aligned Stage 2' filter. I only want to add risk when daily, weekly, and monthly all agree — today the OK scanner is daily-only and I have no monthly confirm. Cuts whipsaw entries on weekly downtrends masquerading as daily breakouts.

feature_requests.title: Sector Rotation RRG (Relative Rotation Graph) vs NIFTY
feature_requests.rationale: Classic RRG with 14 NIFTY sector indices plotted on RS-Ratio vs RS-Momentum axes, tail length 10 weeks, quadrant tagging (Leading/Weakening/Lagging/Improving). Tells me at a glance whether to fish in IT, PSU banks, or pharma this week. Sector-rotation quadrant view doesn't exist in palace yet — current 'rotation' feature is stage-bucket, not RRG.

feature_requests.title: Earnings + Dividend Calendar Overlay on Open Positions
feature_requests.rationale: Show upcoming earnings dates, ex-dividend dates, AGMs, and bonus/split events for every held position with days-to-event countdown and a 'hold-through vs trim-before' recommendation based on historical post-event drift. Critical for positional traders to avoid getting blindsided by a 10% earnings gap against a 2-week swing.

feature_requests.title: Fresh-Breakout vs Extended Classifier (% from 20DMA + base depth)
feature_requests.rationale: For every breakout signal, tag it as 'fresh' (<3% above pivot, <5% from 20DMA, base depth >12%) vs 'extended' (>7% from pivot or >10% from 20DMA). Stops me chasing climactic moves that have already paid out — extended buys are my single biggest loss bucket and nothing in palace flags this today.

feature_requests.title: Opening-Range Breakout Tracker (first 15m high/low per symbol)
feature_requests.rationale: Live grid of watchlist symbols showing the 9:15–9:30 IST opening range (high/low/width as % of ATR), current price position within/outside the range, breakout time, retest count, and volume vs 20-day 15m-avg. Scalpers live or die on the first ORB — eyeballing 30 symbols on TradingView wastes the only edge window of the day.

feature_requests.title: VWAP-Deviation Bands & Mean-Reversion Alert Strip
feature_requests.rationale: Per-symbol live VWAP with ±1σ/±2σ rolling bands (computed from minute-bar dispersion since 9:15), distance-from-VWAP in σ units, and a colour-coded strip flagging stretched names ripe for fade or anchored-VWAP reclaim continuation. Anchored-VWAP is the single most reliable intraday level; right now there's no programmatic σ-band view.

feature_requests.title: Tape-Speed & Volatility-Per-Minute Gauge
feature_requests.rationale: Real-time gauge per symbol showing trades-per-second, rupees-traded-per-minute vs 10-day same-time-of-day baseline, and realised vol per minute. When tape goes cold the spread cost dominates edge; when it accelerates 3× baseline a regime shift is underway. Scalpers need a quantified 'is this tape worth my attention right now' number.

feature_requests.title: Slippage-vs-Edge Calculator per Setup (go/no-go before click)
feature_requests.rationale: Pre-trade panel that takes the candidate setup's historical avg-R, divides by live (half-spread + impact-cost-for-my-size + brokerage) and returns a net-edge-in-ticks number with red/amber/green. Many ORB and VWAP-fade setups have +0.6R gross edge but lose 0.5R to slippage on illiquid mid-caps — this kills the no-trade decision quantitatively.

feature_requests.title: 3:20 PM Forced-Flat Checklist & Auto-Square-Off Cockpit
feature_requests.rationale: Dedicated end-of-day screen that activates at 3:15 IST showing every open intraday position with countdown, current P&L, estimated closing-auction slippage, and a one-click 'flatten all MIS' workflow with confirmation. Also flags any position the system thinks the trader is about to forget to close — carrying intraday MIS into auto-square-off costs penalty + worse fills.

feature_requests.title: Portfolio Exposure Decomposition (gross/net/beta/sector/factor)
feature_requests.rationale: Single screen breaking total capital into gross exposure, net long/short, beta-weighted-to-NIFTY, sector concentration, and factor tilts (momentum/value/lowvol). I need to see if I'm secretly running a 1.4x beta book stuffed into IT+Banks before I add another long. Cockpits today show per-position risk but no aggregate factor view.

feature_requests.title: Capital-at-Risk Heat Strip (open R + theoretical max loss per book)
feature_requests.rationale: Live strip showing for each book (equity intraday / monthly F&O / weekly straddle / pyramid) the open R remaining to SL, theoretical max loss if everything gaps to worst-case, and % of daily-loss-budget consumed. Lets me answer 'can I take one more trade?' in 2 seconds instead of mentally summing across cockpits.

feature_requests.title: Regime Dashboard (VIX term-structure + breadth + trend-day probability)
feature_requests.rationale: Top-of-app banner showing INDIA VIX level + 1d/5d delta, VIX futures term structure slope, NSE advance-decline + new-highs-vs-lows, and a Bayesian trend-day-probability for today based on opening-30m range vs 20-day ATR. Drives sizing multiplier — I trade half-size in chop, full-size on trend days, and the system should make that decision visible not implicit.

feature_requests.title: Strategy Edge-Decay Tracker (rolling 20/60/120-trade expectancy per setup)
feature_requests.rationale: For each registered strategy (ORB, pyramid, straddle, OK swing, screener signals) plot rolling expectancy in R, win-rate, and avg-MAE on a 20/60/120 trade window. When a strategy's 20-trade expectancy crosses below its 120-trade by >0.3R I want a flag — that's the earliest sign edge is decaying and I should cut size or pause it before the monthly report tells me.

feature_requests.title: Correlation-Adjusted Position Sizer (cluster risk before adding)
feature_requests.rationale: Before I click buy, show pairwise 60-day return correlation between the candidate and every open position, cluster anything >0.6 into a 'risk bucket', and reject/warn if the bucket would exceed e.g. 25% of capital post-trade. The existing What-If sizer shows margin and leverage but not 'you already own 4 PSU banks and this is the 5th'.

feature_requests.title: Live Skew & Term-Structure Surface (25Δ RR, fly, IV-rank per expiry)
feature_requests.rationale: Snapshot every 30s of NIFTY/BANKNIFTY ATM IV + 25Δ put/call IV across the next 4 weekly + 2 monthly expiries, with risk-reversal (put-call skew), butterfly, and IV-rank vs 60-day range per expiry. Without this I'm selling premium blind — a -8 vol RR means crash bid, and IV-rank <20 means I should be buying not selling. Plot as a heatmap (expiry × delta-bucket) plus a term-structure line so contango/backwardation jumps out.

feature_requests.title: Live Greeks Aggregator & Delta-Drift Hedge Suggestor
feature_requests.rationale: Real-time per-position and portfolio-aggregated Δ/Γ/Θ/Vega/Vanna with a configurable delta band (e.g. ±0.15 of one lot). When net delta breaches the band, surface the cheapest hedge — futures lots vs nearest OTM option — with cost in ₹ and theta impact. Short-straddle traders die from un-hedged delta excursions; this turns a manual scan into a one-click rebalance.

feature_requests.title: Realised-vs-Implied Vol Ribbon (5m / 1d / 5d with HV-IV spread)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-underlying chart overlaying ATM IV against close-to-close + Parkinson + Yang-Zhang realised vol on 5m/1d/5d windows, with the HV–IV spread plotted underneath. When IV > RV by >3 vol I press premium-selling; when RV is breaking above IV my straddle is bleeding and I need to close or convert. Today I eyeball this from two charts — needs to be one.

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Pin-Risk Radar (max-pain, OI walls, gamma flip)
feature_requests.rationale: Tuesday/Thursday-only cockpit showing live max-pain strike, top-3 OI walls on CE & PE, dealer gamma-exposure profile, and a pin-probability score for the next 60/120/240 minutes. Alerts when spot crosses into a high-gamma strike I'm short, because that's where assignment + whipsaw kills straddle P&L. Replaces my mental math at 2:30 PM with a real number.

feature_requests.title: Per-Strategy Theta-Burn & Vega-Bleed Schedule
feature_requests.rationale: For every open options structure (straddle, vertical, pyramid) project the cumulative theta captured and vega P&L every 30min from now to expiry under flat-spot + ±1σ scenarios, plotted as a decay curve. Helps decide hold-vs-roll: if 70% of theta is already captured by Friday close on a Tuesday-expiry straddle, the carry isn't worth the gamma. Today I guess this from a payoff diagram — it should be a schedule.

feature_requests.title: Live Basis & Cost-of-Carry Curve (spot vs current/next/far month)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-underlying chart streaming spot vs current/next/far-month futures with basis in points and annualised cost-of-carry %, overlaid on the implied risk-free rate. Lets me spot when current-month flips to discount (long unwind) or next-month basis blows wide (carry trade opportunity) before placing a futures leg.

feature_requests.title: OI Quadrant Heatmap (long build-up / short cover / long unwind / short build-up)
feature_requests.rationale: Sortable grid of NIFTY/BANKNIFTY + F&O stock universe classifying each into the 4 OI×price quadrants on 1d/5d, with %ΔOI, %ΔPrice, and notional rupee OI change. Surfaces which names smart money is actually adding to vs covering, which is the single most important read for futures positioning.

feature_requests.title: Roll-Spread Calendar & Rollover Cost Tracker
feature_requests.rationale: T-7 to expiry cockpit showing daily roll spread (next - current) in points and bps, rollover % completed vs 3-month average, and which stocks are rolling rich vs cheap. Tells me whether to roll early, wait, or skip the roll entirely based on cost vs historical norm.

feature_requests.title: SPAN+ELM Margin Efficiency Table (notional ÷ margin per position)
feature_requests.rationale: Per open futures position show SPAN + Exposure margin, total blocked, notional exposure, and notional/margin leverage ratio, with portfolio-level margin utilisation and headroom. Critical to know before adding a new lot whether I'll trip the broker margin call vs how much carry I'm actually getting per rupee blocked.

feature_requests.title: Futures–Cash Arbitrage Scanner (basis vs theoretical fair value)
feature_requests.rationale: Scan F&O stocks for futures trading at >0.5% premium or discount to theoretical fair value (spot × e^(r-d)t), ranked by annualised arb yield net of impact + STT. Even if I'm not running the arb, the divergence flags dividend surprises, borrow-cost spikes, or short squeezes worth a directional bet.

feature_requests.title: RS-vs-NIFTY Leaderboard (Mansfield + IBD-style RS rank)

Lets me focus only on top-quartile RS names for swing longs and bottom-quartile for shorts, instead of hunting setups in laggards.

feature_requests.title: Multi-Timeframe Stage Scanner (Weinstein Stage 1-4 on D/W/M)
feature_requests.rationale: Per-symbol classifier tagging each stock as Stage 1 (basing) / 2 (advancing) / 3 (topping) / 4 (declining) on daily, weekly, and monthly using 30-week MA slope + price-vs-MA + volume profile. Only Stage 2 on all three frames is swing-long-eligible; surfaces stage transitions as early-entry alerts.

feature_requests.title: FII/DII Cash + F&O Flow Tape with Index Overlay
feature_requests.rationale: Daily and 5/20-day rolling FII + DII cash buy/sell, FII index-futures net OI change, and FII index-options net premium, overlaid on NIFTY closing line.
